newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A ratings to Toshiba Capital Euro note.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A ratings to Toshiba Capital Euro note.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Wednesday that it had assigned A ratings to Toshiba America Capital Corp's $300 million Euro medium-term note programme and Toshiba Capital (Asia) Ltd's $300 million Euro medium-term note programme.
The outlook for the ratings is stable, S&P said in a statement.
Toshiba America Capital benefits from a keepwell agreement with Toshiba Corp and an unconditional guarantee offered by Toshiba America Inc, S&P said.
Toshiba Capital (Asia) benefits from a keepwell agreement with Toshiba Corp, it added.
